description: This is the main script for the DU Health Check CLI tool. It performs comprehensive health checks on DU (Distributed Units) in a Kubernetes environment, including retrieving kubeconfig, listing nodes and pods, collecting logs and metrics, checking connectivity, and publishing results to Kafka and Loki. It exposes a command-line interface and a run_cli function for programmatic use.

methods.name: None _apply_overrides(cfg: AppConfig, site_id: Optional[str], environment: Optional[str], overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Apply optional site_id, environment, and config field overrides to the AppConfig instance.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_connectivity(cfg: AppConfig)
methods.description: Perform TCP connectivity checks to CU and RU endpoints based on configuration settings.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _report_to_dict(report)
methods.description: Convert a HealthResult dataclass instance to a dictionary format for JSON serialization.

methods.name: argparse.Namespace _parse_args()
methods.description: Parse command-line arguments for the CLI interface.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_cli(site_id: Optional[str] = None, environment: Optional[str] = None, overrides: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Main workflow function to execute the health check process, either as a script or programmatically, returning a structured result.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Script entry point. Parses CLI parameters and executes the health check workflow, handling logging and error reporting.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_overrides_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace)
methods.description: Construct overrides dictionary from command-line arguments.

methods.name: None _publish_to_kafka_safe(cfg: AppConfig, result: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger, also_push_loki: bool)
methods.description: Attempt to publish results to Kafka and push error logs to Loki in case of failure.
